title: ML Engineer
description: A structured path through machine learning foundations and practice.

nodes.title: Math foundations
nodes.summary: Review the linear algebra, calculus, and statistics used in machine learning.

nodes.title: Python data stack
nodes.summary: Work fluently with NumPy, Pandas, and notebooks.

nodes.title: Data preparation
nodes.summary: Clean, validate, and prepare datasets for model development.

nodes.title: Supervised learning
nodes.summary: Fit and evaluate regression and classification models.

nodes.title: Model evaluation
nodes.summary: Choose metrics, validate models, and understand overfitting.

nodes.title: Unsupervised learning
nodes.summary: Explore clustering and dimensionality reduction techniques.

nodes.title: Neural networks
nodes.summary: Learn the building blocks of deep learning and neural networks.

nodes.title: Model serving
nodes.summary: Package a trained model behind a reliable inference interface.

nodes.title: Monitoring & iteration
nodes.summary: Track model behavior and plan thoughtful updates.

nodes.title: Milestone: ship an ML project
nodes.summary: Apply the workflow from data preparation through deployment.
